core_obligations: Reduce to a constructible coefficient sheaf (proof lines 14911-14927): by the torsion-colimit and colimit lemmas there is a constructible G with a map G -> F such that xi comes from a class zeta on Z; if an injection G -> G' kills zeta, then the pushout F' = G' coproduct_G F is injective with F and kills xi, because restriction to Z is exact and commutes with the relevant colimits; hence one may assume F constructible.
Reduce to a finite pushforward of a constant sheaf (proof lines 14929-14938): the embedding lemma lets one assume F = f_*underline M with M finite abelian and f finite of finite presentation.

Compute on the cover (proof lines 14939-14952): formation of f_* commutes with base change, so the restriction of f_*M to Z is the pushforward along Y x_X Z -> Z; Leray together with the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism gives H^q(Z, f_*M|_Z) = H^q(Y x_X Z, M), and the integral cover lemma produces a finite surjective finitely presented Y' -> Y killing xi on Y' x_X Z.

Injectivity of f_*M -> f'_*M (proof lines 14953-14967): for a geometric point x of X the stalk of f_*underline M is the direct sum of the copies of M indexed by the geometric points y of Y over x, and the same description holds for f'; since Y' -> Y is finite surjective the induced map on geometric points over x is surjective, so the map of stalks is injective, which finishes the proof.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a constructible coefficient sheaf using the colimit description and a pushout argument.
Reduce further to a finite pushforward of a constant sheaf and compute the relevant cohomology on the base-changed cover by Leray.
Kill the class by the integral cover and verify injectivity of the inclusion of pushforwards by a stalk computation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that on an affine scheme any cohomology class in positive degree on a closed subscheme is killed after embedding the coefficient sheaf into a larger torsion sheaf (statement lines 14900-14908). The proof (proof lines 14910-14967) reduces to a constructible coefficient sheaf by a colimit argument and a pushout, then to a finite pushforward of a constant sheaf by the embedding lemma, computes the cohomology on the base-changed cover through Leray and the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism, kills the class by the integral cover, and verifies injectivity of the inclusion of pushforwards by a stalk computation. H2: a three-step reduction with an explicit cover, all written out.
